title: SD Card Health Degradation Trend
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f3:card error_blocks=* card_label=*
| timechart span=1mon max(error_blocks) as worst_error_blocks by card_label
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends the worst block-error count seen during each monthly SD-card validation run.
value: Card degradation is easy to ignore until it eats a shoot; a simple monthly trend gives you a replacement signal.
implementation: Run F3 or F3X after heavy shoots, parse the results into `f3:card`, and review the worst error count per card each month.
visualization: Multi-series line chart of monthly worst error-block count by card.
grandmaExplanation: It spots whether any memory card is slowly going bad before it ruins important photos.
